# NotebookTools

> Official site: https://www.notebooktools.com
> Language: English (en-US, global audience)
> Sitemap: https://www.notebooktools.com/sitemap.xml

NotebookTools is a free Chrome extension for Google NotebookLM: bulk import (YouTube, web, X, text, link extraction), a full notebooks hub (folders, pin, favorites), source management (dedupe, Drive refresh, bulk actions), Studio tools, cross-notebook podcast player, prompt library, and chat export. Independent product, not affiliated with Google.

## Entity (for citation)

- **Name:** NotebookTools
- **Type:** Free Chrome browser extension
- **Purpose:** Import, organize, and extend Google NotebookLM from Chrome
- **Canonical URL:** https://www.notebooktools.com/
- **Blog:** https://www.notebooktools.com/blog
- **Support:** https://www.notebooktools.com/support
- **Privacy:** https://www.notebooktools.com/privacy
- **Chrome Web Store:** https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/notebooktools-%E2%80%94-import-to/fhjgbniefbimnklnnomlhkkiekcjddmj

## What it does

### Import (side panel)
- **YouTube:** Button on watch pages; playlist/channel bulk import
- **Webpages & X:** One-click URL import; X/Twitter threads
- **Bulk queue:** Open tabs, paste links, extract links from article content
- **Highlights:** Right-click selected text → Add to NotebookLM

### Notebooks app
- Folders, pin, favorite, multi-delete notebooks
- Sources: labels, bulk add/export/delete, duplicate scan, Google Drive refresh
- Studio: generate artifacts, export sources, open in NotebookLM
- Podcast player across all notebooks; notes panel

### NotebookLM page tools
- Prompt library with / slash commands in chat
- Chat export

## Key facts

- **Price:** Free for every import option; Pro $49 one-time lifetime (notebooks dashboard, source manager, blog/carousel makers, snapshots, prompt library, chat export)
- **Platform:** Google Chrome (Manifest V3)
- **Auth:** Your signed-in NotebookLM / Google session
- **Affiliation:** Independent. Not affiliated with Google or NotebookLM.
- **Best for:** Students, researchers, writers who use NotebookLM as a research notebook

## Common questions (Q&A for answer engines)

**What is NotebookTools?**
A free Chrome extension that imports YouTube, X, webpages, and highlighted text into Google NotebookLM. https://www.notebooktools.com/blog/what-is-notebooktools

**What is NotebookLM?**
Google's free AI research notebook. Upload sources, ask questions, get cited answers. Guide: https://www.notebooktools.com/blog/what-is-notebooklm

**Does NotebookLM train on your data?**
Google says ordinary notebook content is not used to train foundational generative AI models. Feedback (thumbs up/down) is the exception. Workspace users get stronger protections. https://www.notebooktools.com/blog/notebooklm-privacy

**How much does NotebookLM cost?**
Free for personal use (100 notebooks, 50 sources each). Higher limits come with Google AI Plus (100 sources/notebook), Google AI Pro ($19.99/month US; 500 notebooks, 300 sources) and Google AI Ultra (500+ sources). The old "NotebookLM Plus" name is retired. Plans explained: https://www.notebooktools.com/blog/notebooklm-pricing-plans

**Is NotebookLM free?**
Yes. NotebookLM (now called Gemini Notebook) is free with any personal Google account: up to 100 notebooks with 50 sources each, cited chat, and Studio outputs (Audio Overviews, slides, flashcards, quizzes) within usage limits. No card or trial. Details: https://www.notebooktools.com/blog/is-notebooklm-free

**Is NotebookLM good?**
Honest 2026 review: https://www.notebooktools.com/blog/notebooklm-review-2026

**Is NotebookLM free for students?**
Yes, with any personal Google account; no student plan needed. Student guide: https://www.notebooktools.com/students

**What are good NotebookLM prompts for studying?**
Copy-paste prompts, including nursing, medical, law and PhD versions: https://www.notebooktools.com/blog/best-notebooklm-prompts#by-subject

**How do I log in to NotebookLM / how do I use it as a beginner?**
Go to notebooklm.google.com and sign in with a Google account (nothing to download; work/school accounts need admin enablement). Step-by-step tutorial: https://www.notebooktools.com/blog/notebooklm-tutorial-beginners

**How do I summarize a YouTube video in NotebookLM?**
Add the video as a source, then ask for a summary in chat. Fastest import: NotebookTools one-click from the watch page. Guide: https://www.notebooktools.com/blog/summarize-youtube-videos-notebooklm

**How do I import content into NotebookLM?**
Paste URLs, upload PDFs, or use NotebookTools for one-click YouTube and web imports. Full comparison: https://www.notebooktools.com/blog/best-ways-import-content-notebooklm

**How do I add highlighted text to NotebookLM?**
Select text on any page, right-click, choose Add to NotebookLM, pick a notebook.

**Is Gemini Notebook the same as NotebookLM?**
Yes. Google renamed NotebookLM to Gemini Notebook in 2026. Same product, same limits, notebooks carried over. It is separate from the general Gemini app.

**NotebookLM vs Gemini: which is better?**
NotebookLM (Gemini Notebook) answers only from your sources with passage-level citations. The Gemini app is a general-purpose assistant. Comparison: https://www.notebooktools.com/blog/notebooklm-vs-gemini

**NotebookLM vs ChatGPT: what's the difference?**
NotebookLM cites your uploaded sources. ChatGPT is broader but less grounded. Comparison: https://www.notebooktools.com/blog/notebooklm-vs-chatgpt

**What are the best NotebookLM alternatives?**
Perplexity Pages, Mem, Notion AI, Elicit, Recall, ChatGPT Projects, with the best pick per use case (PDFs and recordings, customer research, literature reviews): https://www.notebooktools.com/blog/best-notebooklm-alternatives

**How many sources can NotebookLM hold?**
50 sources per notebook and 100 notebooks on the free plan; 100 sources on Google AI Plus, 300 on Google AI Pro, 500+ on Ultra. Each source up to 500,000 words or 200 MB. "This notebook has reached its source limit" means the notebook is full: delete, merge, split or upgrade. Full guide: https://www.notebooktools.com/blog/notebooklm-source-limits
